feature: AI Production Director and independent backing layers
reviewCorrections: First-time HUM direction opens the editable Director before any blueprint exists.
Scoped AI refinements reject unrelated global, instrument and target-property changes.
Trailing drum-off and negated-removal instructions retain their requested meaning.
Soft piano does not reduce adjacent guitar gain; light drums changes drum gain.
Final-section strings and selected production styles affect actual backing events.
limitations: Pitch detection and MIDI are estimates; universal humming, singing and whistling transcription is not established.
The user's current sparse pitch evidence cannot authorize guessed harmonic backing; the original waveform remains the lead.
Instrument sounds are Web Audio synth approximations, not sampled acoustic instruments or commercial mastering.
OpenAI planning is optional and currently the UI reports a local planner. Live provider inference was not tested.
The existing MusicGen Melody reference-audio adapter remains a separate optional preview. Real neural inference was not run.
Native waveform fixtures establish render preservation, not the accuracy of unannotated human transcription.
Original audio remains session-only; saved projects retain the blueprint and notes but require source reattachment.
